title: BAYSWATER,VIC-3153 - Remediate the Network
current_summary: Emergency maintenance to remediate a network issue in Bayswater (VIC 3153) was carried out by an upstream provider. The planned window was 26 July 2026 from 3:47 PM to 6:47 PM AEST, during which services in the area may have experienced a temporary loss of connectivity. The work is complete.

updates.content: We’re aware of emergency maintenance that took place in Bayswater (VIC 3153) on 26 July 2026. Some services in the area may have briefly lost connectivity during the planned window from 3:47 PM to 6:47 PM AEST. This work is now complete and no further impact is expected. If your service is still not working, please restart your modem/router and contact our support team so we can help.
